chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah, from 'Abd Allah ibn Sinan, from Abu 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
The takbir over the deceased is five takbirs.

key_terms.التَّكْبِيرُ: the pronouncement of 'Allahu Akbar' in the funeral prayer
key_terms.الْمَيِّتِ: the deceased person over whom the funeral prayer is performed

ai.seo_question: How many takbirs are said over the deceased in the funeral prayer according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith states the legal ruling for the funeral prayer over the deceased: it consists of five takbirs. It is a concise jurisprudential report that establishes the number of takbirs in salat over the dead in Shia fiqh.
